name: The Atlas Cedar of Villa delle Rose

access: Free public gardens, gallery hours (Galleria d'Arte Moderna, Villa delle Rose)

verify_notes: A large Atlas cedar (545cm girth, 32m tall), register-confirmed, in the public gardens of Villa delle Rose, a municipal modern-art venue (Galleria d'Arte Moderna) on Via Saragozza. Gardens are free but keep gallery-style opening hours rather than a public park's, which the access field states honestly. Single-sourced to the national MASAF monumental tree register, flagged accordingly.
